items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I saw him -- funny incident -- opened in my home town in the thirties, Jack Teagarden on the trombone, and a very great trombonist called George Troup.

ctx.x: With this road band, but they didn't last very long. He was trying to make a comeback with all these great names, you know? He had Jack Teagarden with him for awhile, and I saw him -- funny incident -- opened in my home town in the thirties, Jack Teagarden on the trombone, and a very great trombonist called George Troup.
